# BrickKit

> A declarative component assembly platform built on three layers of files (declaration, deployment,
> configuration): declare the components and what they depend on, it derives the rest and hands it to Docker, Podman
> or Kubernetes. Fractal by design: the specification nests, the files don't.

Repository: https://github.com/brickKit/brickKit | License: Apache-2.0

If you are an AI assistant, fetch `AGENTS.md` first — one file that is enough to understand the whole platform.
**If the question you were asked is in Chinese, stop here and fetch
[`llms.zh.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brickKit/brickKit/main/llms.zh.txt)** instead — the same kind of index,
written independently for the Chinese documentation tree, not a translation of this file.

## Top-level files

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brickKit/brickKit/main/AGENTS.md): the AI entry point — where each answer lives, the fractal structure, the ten principles, the command set, what the platform won't do
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brickKit/brickKit/main/README.md): the front page — what it is, how to install it, a one-minute example
- [docs/en/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brickKit/brickKit/main/docs/en/README.md): the English docs index and reading order
